title: Meadow vs. Flowhub: 2026 Dispensary POS Comparison
summary: Compare Meadow vs. Flowhub on pricing model, traceability coverage, delivery, eCommerce, loyalty, and G2 reviews, and see which operations each one fits.
body_markdown:
Meadow and Flowhub are both cannabis POS platforms with Metrc integrations. The biggest difference is packaging: Flowhub lists its POS, eCommerce, Marketing Suite, and mobile apps as separate products and prices by custom quote, while Meadow runs POS, delivery, eCommerce, loyalty, and compliance on one flat monthly fee.


That difference shows up in two places: your invoice and your back office. Every separate product or add-on vendor is another line item, another login, and another set of numbers that has to match Metrc.


**This Meadow vs. Flowhub comparison covers packaging, compliance coverage, delivery, eCommerce, marketing, and payments, shares what verified reviewers say about each, and lays out which operations each platform fits.**

## Meadow vs. Flowhub at a Glance


Flowhub is a modular cannabis POS whose clearest fit is broad traceability coverage, while Meadow is an all-in-one platform built for dispensaries and delivery operators in Metrc states.


**Flowhub** pairs its Maui POS with separately listed products, including Ecommerce, Marketing Suite, Kiosk, and the Stash, View, and Greet mobile apps, plus an open API for third-party tools. It integrates with both Metrc and BioTrack and lists more than 30 states on its markets page. The trade-off is assembly: each product and each partner integration is one more thing to price, configure, and keep in sync.


**Meadow** runs[POS](https://getmeadow.com/features/point-of-sale) , eCommerce, delivery, loyalty, SMS marketing, and Metrc compliance in one system, with one login, one inventory count, and one flat monthly fee per location. It serves operators in California, New York, New Jersey, Michigan, Massachusetts, and Minnesota.


**The short version:** if you operate in a BioTrack state or a market Meadow doesn't serve, Flowhub's coverage is the deciding factor. If you're in one of Meadow's six states and spend more time managing software than your sales floor, one system on one bill is the simpler path.


For the full field, see[The Best Dispensary Point of Sale Systems for 2026](https://getmeadow.com/blog/best-dispensary-pos) .

## Questions to Ask as You Evaluate


Four questions separate Meadow and Flowhub faster than a feature list, so bring them to both demos.


### 1. Which traceability system does your state use?


Meadow integrates with Metrc, and Flowhub supports both Metrc and BioTrack. If your state runs on Metrc and you operate in one of Meadow's six states, both platforms qualify and the comparison moves to everything else. If you need BioTrack, that narrows the field before features come into it.


### 2. What will the full quote include?


Ask each vendor to itemize what's included and what costs extra: eCommerce, marketing, loyalty, kiosks, mobile apps, delivery tools, implementation, and hardware. Then add the monthly cost of every third-party tool you'd still need, such as a delivery logistics provider or a texting platform. Our[cannabis POS pricing guide](https://getmeadow.com/blog/cannabis-pos-pricing) breaks down how each pricing model adds up.


### 3. Who runs delivery from order to doorstep?


If delivery is a core channel, ask where dispatch, routing, driver tracking, and Metrc manifests live. Every handoff between systems is another place an order can stall or a count can drift.


### 4. What happens on 4/20?


Ask for documented uptime and the record on the last few 4/20s, in writing, and ask who answers support during a Saturday rush and how fast. Your busiest day is the wrong day to learn the answer.


For more questions to bring to a demo, see our[Flowhub alternatives guide](https://getmeadow.com/blog/flowhub-alternatives) .

## How Meadow and Flowhub Compare, Feature by Feature


Meadow and Flowhub overlap on core POS, eCommerce, and Metrc compliance, and they differ most on packaging, traceability coverage, delivery, marketing channels, and payments.


### Packaging and Pricing


Packaging is the clearest difference between Meadow and Flowhub. Flowhub prices through a sales quote and lists Maui POS, Ecommerce, Marketing Suite, Kiosk, and its mobile apps as separate products, so ask which ones your quote includes and which are add-ons. Meadow charges[one flat monthly fee per location](https://getmeadow.com/pricing) that covers POS, eCommerce, delivery, loyalty, inventory, and compliance, with no per-transaction fees.


### Compliance and Traceability


Meadow and Flowhub both integrate directly with Metrc, and Flowhub also supports BioTrack, which is the main reason operators in BioTrack states consider it.


Meadow[connects directly to Metrc's API](https://getmeadow.com/features/metrc-compliance) , so every sale, adjustment, and delivery updates Metrc automatically, and Meadow's team monitors each store's Metrc sync to resolve errors before they become compliance risks. Adjustments and delivery ledgers happen inside Meadow, so staff open Metrc mainly to receive new deliveries.


### Delivery


Delivery runs natively in Meadow, while Flowhub handles delivery orders in its POS and relies on an Onfleet integration for drivers.


Flowhub creates delivery orders and automated Metrc delivery manifests in its POS. Its driver app, dispatch, route optimization, and live tracking come through an optional Onfleet integration, which requires a separate Onfleet account and gives drivers a separate app.


Meadow supports[hub-and-spoke, dynamic (ice cream truck), and hybrid delivery](https://getmeadow.com/features/cannabis-delivery) natively, with dispatching, tracking, customer communications, geofencing, and California delivery ledgers built in. In dynamic delivery, each vehicle operates as its own inventory location with its own menu.


### eCommerce


Meadow and Flowhub both offer native online ordering. Flowhub lists its Ecommerce product separately from the POS. Meadow's[eCommerce](https://getmeadow.com/features/ecommerce) and online menus are included in the platform fee, draw from the same inventory count as the sales floor, and come with Meadow SEO+, so menu pages are built to be found in search.


### Marketing and Loyalty


Flowhub's Marketing Suite covers loyalty, customer segments, email campaigns, and push notifications delivered through Apple and Google Wallet loyalty passes, which Flowhub uses in place of SMS. Meadow includes built-in[loyalty and rewards](https://getmeadow.com/features/loyalty-and-rewards) and SMS marketing in the platform fee, and runs loyalty redemptions through the same discount engine as every other promotion.


### Payments


Flowhub offers Flowhub Payments, its own debit and ACH product. Meadow supports[integrated PIN debit, wireless terminals, and eCommerce ACH](https://getmeadow.com/blog/dispensary-cashless-payments) , all connected to the POS, inventory, and Metrc, with no payment processor lock-in.

## Which Platform Fits Your Operation


Meadow fits dispensaries and delivery operators in its six Metrc states that want one system, and Flowhub fits operators who need BioTrack or a state Meadow doesn't serve.


**Consider Flowhub if** you operate in a BioTrack state or a market outside Meadow's six states and want one vendor across them. The trade-off: POS, eCommerce, marketing, and mobile apps are listed as separate products, and drivers work in Onfleet, so budget for itemized pricing and more systems to manage.


**Choose Meadow if:**


- Delivery is a core channel, including dynamic (ice cream truck) delivery.
- You want POS, eCommerce, delivery, loyalty, and compliance on one bill with no per-transaction fees.
- Peak-day reliability and fast support matter as much as features.
- You operate in California, New York, New Jersey, Michigan, Massachusetts, or Minnesota.

## What to Look for in a Long-Term POS Partner


The right POS partner is one you'd still pick after your state's next rule change, so weigh track record as heavily as today's feature list.


- **Years in cannabis retail.** A vendor that has worked through rule changes in your state handles the next one without you explaining it.
- **Support that's included.** Ask whether support is free, how fast it answers, and whether the people answering know Metrc.
- **A documented peak-day record.** Uptime numbers and 4/20 history, in writing.
- **One source of truth.** Every system you add is another set of numbers to reconcile against Metrc.


Meadow has built cannabis retail software since 2014 as Y Combinator's first cannabis startup and has processed more than $5 billion in retail orders.

## Common Questions


### Is Meadow or Flowhub better for cannabis delivery?


Meadow is the stronger fit for most delivery operators in its six states. Delivery is native in Meadow, including hub-and-spoke, dynamic (ice cream truck), and hybrid models with dispatch, tracking, and geofencing built in. Flowhub manages delivery orders and Metrc manifests in its POS and runs drivers, routing, and live tracking through its Onfleet integration.


### How does Flowhub's pricing compare to Meadow's?


Flowhub prices by custom quote and lists its POS, Ecommerce, Marketing Suite, Kiosk, and mobile apps as separate products, so ask for an itemized quote. Meadow charges one flat monthly fee per location that covers POS, eCommerce, delivery, loyalty, and compliance, with no per-transaction fees.


### Can I switch from Flowhub to Meadow without downtime?


Yes. Meadow runs a provider-led migration that cleans up Metrc data first, trains staff before go-live, and cuts over overnight, so you open the next morning on the new system. See[How to Switch Dispensary POS Without Losing a Day of Sales](https://getmeadow.com/blog/dispensary-pos-migration) for the full playbook.


### Does Meadow work with BioTrack?


No. Meadow integrates with Metrc and serves operators in California, New York, New Jersey, Michigan, Massachusetts, and Minnesota. Operators in BioTrack states need a platform that supports BioTrack, such as Flowhub.
